repositories.name: raghavk92/Kontroller
repositories.why: Android phone as mouse/keyboard using the public Android 9+ Bluetooth HID Device profile. Useful for sender-app lifecycle, SDP registration and UX constraints.
repositories.caution: Sender-side precedent only. Do not import UI or app assumptions into TS18 host workflow. Android phone must remain peripheral; TS18 remains host.

repositories.name: LiangLuDev/HidPeripheral
repositories.license: Unverified from search; inspect LICENSE before reuse
repositories.why: Small Android HID Device mouse/keyboard simulation app; likely useful for getProfileProxy/registerApp/SdpSettings/report descriptor examples.
repositories.caution: Inspect licence and code age before copying. Reference behaviour only unless licence is confirmed.

repositories.name: T-Dynamos/USBtoBLHid
repositories.category: Android USB HID to Bluetooth HID Device bridge
repositories.why: Android registers as Bluetooth HID Device, listens to USB keyboard/mouse input and sends HID reports over Bluetooth. Useful for report conversion and connected-host state handling.
repositories.caution: This is a sender/bridge app, not a TS18 HID Host implementation. Do not adapt USB-host assumptions to BTAndroidTS host pairing flow.

repositories.name: kshoji/BLE-HID-Peripheral-for-Android
repositories.why: Android BLE HID over GATT profile library; Android behaves as BLE mouse/keyboard/joystick. Useful for HOGP service/report evidence and host expectations.
repositories.caution: BTAndroidTS should not become a BLE HID peripheral; use this to recognise and classify phone apps that expose HOGP.

repositories.name: Aleksander-Drewnicki/BLE_HID_EXAMPLE
repositories.why: Android peripheral/server app emulating BLE HID mouse/keyboard. Useful as a compact HOGP example to cross-check service and report-map assumptions.
repositories.caution: Example app. Use only as precedent for expected BLE evidence; not as production host code.

repositories.name: NordicSemiconductor/Android-Scanner-Compat-Library
repositories.why: A long-lived BLE scanner compatibility library handling Android API changes, hardware filtering/batching and scan settings. Useful for staged scan design and fallback thinking.
repositories.caution: Do not add a dependency without size/API29/TS18 validation. Inspect as design reference first.

repositories.name: NordicSemiconductor/Android-BLE-Library
repositories.why: Production-oriented Android BLE library for GATT connection management. It explicitly separates scanning from connection management and points to scanner compat for scanning.
repositories.caution: Do not use it as proof of TS18 runtime behaviour; dependency adoption requires validation and binary impact review.

repositories.name: nordicsemi/Kotlin-BLE-Library
repositories.why: Modern Kotlin/coroutines BLE wrapper. Useful for Flow/state modelling ideas compatible with BTAndroidTS' Kotlin/Compose direction.
repositories.caution: Beta/newer library. Do not adopt wholesale for Android 10 TS18 without careful dependency and API29 testing.

repositories.name: weliem/blessed-android
repositories.why: Compact Android BLE library with broad real-world use. Useful for comparing connection management, callback threading and error handling.
repositories.caution: Reference only unless adopted behind BTAndroidTS adapters with API29 and TS18 validation.

repositories.name: opendroneid/receiver-android
repositories.category: Android BLE scanner app using extended advertising
repositories.why: Real app precedent for extended BLE scanning, capability checks and low-latency scan settings. Useful for staged scan pass implementation.
repositories.caution: Different domain; only use scanner mechanics and validation mindset.

repositories.name: Alkaid-Benetnash/EmuBTHID
repositories.category: BlueZ Classic Bluetooth HID Device emulator
repositories.why: Classic Bluetooth HID Device precedent on Linux/BlueZ; registers HID service UUID 00001124 and exposes keyboard/mouse. Useful to distinguish Classic HID from BLE/HOGP.
repositories.caution: Linux/BlueZ/root precedent only. Do not apply BlueZ commands or privileged port assumptions to TS18 Android.

official_refs.name: Android BluetoothHidDevice API reference

official_refs.why: Primary source for BLE scan behaviour, including unfiltered scan screen-off behaviour and Android 10 location permission requirement.

official_refs.name: Android ScanSettings.Builder API reference
official_refs.why: Primary source for setLegacy, setPhy, setReportDelay and low-latency scan mode behaviour.

official_refs.name: AOSP HidHostService.java
official_refs.why: AOSP source reference for HID Host state/policy and hidden/privileged boundaries.

official_refs.why: Architecture reference for Android Bluetooth app, Binder/JNI and stack/HAL separation.
